# North Wales Lawn Care

> Professional lawn care treatments for homes and businesses across North Wales. Locally owned, fully insured, and competitively priced.

## About

North Wales Lawn Care is a locally owned and operated lawn treatment provider. We serve residential and commercial properties across Conwy, Gwynedd, Anglesey, and Denbighshire. We are fully insured and pride ourselves on delivering reliable, high-quality lawn care at honest prices.

We offer one-off treatments as well as full seasonal lawn care programmes. All work is carried out by a friendly, professional team who treat every garden with care and attention.

## Services

- **Feed & Weed**: Professional feed and weed treatment to nourish your lawn and eliminate unwanted weeds.
- **Scarification**: Removal of built-up thatch and dead material that suffocates your lawn, allowing it to breathe and grow.
- **Moss Control**: Targeted moss treatment to clear moss and prevent it from returning, leaving your lawn cleaner and healthier.
- **Aeration**: Relieves soil compaction and allows air, water, and nutrients to reach the roots for a stronger lawn.

## Areas Covered

We provide lawn care services throughout North Wales, including:

- Conwy
- Gwynedd
- Anglesey (Ynys Môn)
- Denbighshire

Towns and areas served include (but are not limited to): Llandudno, Colwyn Bay, Abergele, Rhyl, Prestatyn, Bangor, Caernarfon, Pwllheli, Criccieth, Porthmadog, Blaenau Ffestiniog, Betws-y-Coed, Llanrwst, Conwy Town, Llanfairfechan, Penmaenmawr, Beaumaris, Llangefni, Holyhead, Amlwch, Menai Bridge, Ruthin, Denbigh, St Asaph, Rhuddlan.
